practiceQuestions.prompt: The sequence of events from one cell division to the next cell division is called

In a stem cell, identify the phase in interphase in which the DNA is replicated to form an identical chromosome.
Which term matches this description? A DNA molecule with associated proteins, organized as a distinct genetic unit.
Which term matches this description? DNA and its associated proteins in the nucleus, often less condensed between divisions.
Which term matches this description? A pair of chromosomes with the same genes at corresponding loci, one typically inherited from each parent.
Which term matches this description? One of each type of chromosome characteristic of a species.
Which term matches this description? The ordered sequence of growth, DNA replication and division in a dividing cell.
Which term matches this description? The G1, S and G2 parts of the cycle between divisions.
Which term matches this description? The part of interphase during which DNA is replicated.
Which term matches this description? The two replicated copies of a chromosome before their separation.

multiSelectPractice.prompt: Select the TWO accurate statements about chromosomes, dna and chromosome sets.
options: Chromatin is a different hereditary molecule from DNA.
Homologues are not the same as two copies made by DNA replication.
A chromosome set means two sister chromatids.
